khaya.cp: masc. waste; destruction; decay; consummation of.
khaya.p: [Khi+ṇa.khi+a.dhāna,ṭī.763.nīti,dhā.18.dhāna,ṭī.323.] (pu) CL=7 (1) It runs out. It destroys. (2) It is a cessation of (Kilesā) that is Nibbāna.
